description: Property Sales and Trends, WA is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Landgate, Government of Western Australia. Data for top weekly property sales by suburb, gross rental value (GRV) statistics, and unimproved value (UV) statistics in Western Australia are published by Landgate, WA government. Weekly sales data includes the top 10 suburbs by total turnover and by numbers sold. Weekly top 10 most expensive and most affordable sales lists include price, street name, suburb, land area, and number of bedrooms and bathrooms. Coverage is the states and territories, 2018 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as weekly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-26. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
